title: Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the energy of the system as E = -MH.

title: Total Magnetic Moment
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the total magnetic moment M = N * average magnetic moment per particle.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the energy E = -N * mu_0 * H * tanh(mu_0 * H / kT).

title: Heat Capacity Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the heat capacity C_H correctly from the energy expression.

title: Entropy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the entropy S using the partition function.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in energy and magnetic moment expressions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Thermal Equilibrium Assumption
description: Important Criteria: The student should clearly state the assumption of thermal equilibrium at temperature T.
